name: app-black-design-process-cards-with-tag-pills
title: Black Design Process Cards with Tag Pills
whatItIs: A black slide with a small label and paragraph, and three tall rounded cards (Discovery, UX Design, UI Design & Branding) each with outlined activity pills at the bottom, the last card cream with a tilted lime pill.
whatItMeans: Stage cards with tag lists summarise a process compactly, and the pale card marks the final stage.
techniques: Cards with content anchored to the bottom, leaving headroom
One tilted lime pill as a playful highlight
Small caps label and two-line paragraph at top

vocabulary.definition: A rounded label naming an activity.
A card with opposite colours to its neighbours.
Content pinned to the base of a card.
